title: Rewrites transport carefully, but preserves independent initial constituent counts
finding: GPT-5.6 Terra High rewrote the solver and added validation. The final correlate() still multiplied the relaxation propagator by diag(totals), even though it computed the charge-conditioned susceptibility for the relaxation rate.

actions.action: Starts a full rewrite of model.py.
Runs public tests and transport checks.
Reruns public tests and further numerical checks.

diagnosis: Wrong equilibrium initial covariance. Mean transport errors remain small, but fluctuation-group errors are 42.15–59.41%. Replacing diag(totals) with the already-computed susceptibility reduces those errors to at most 0.00308%.
confidence: Confirmed by a targeted diagnostic intervention
